title: Totally Legit Enchants
description: Totally Legit Enchants adds three joke enchantments that are absolutely fair, definitely balanced, and clearly not suspicious.
body:
# Intro
Totally Legit Enchants adds three joke enchantments that are absolutely fair, definitely balanced, and clearly not suspicious.

The three enchantments: Cheating saves you from falls, Combat Log disconnects before falling into lava, and CapCut saves you from failed MLG water bucket attempts.

# Version
Totally Legit Enchants is only compatible with 1.21.11 Fabric at the moment, but I will soon update it to newer versions.
